headline: Micron advertises full-chip AMS verification with AI-agent development and output evaluation
fact: Micron's employer-attributed LinkedIn posting JR113919 assigns block-to-full-chip AMS verification spanning analog circuitry, digital logic and firmware, including power-loss and brownout checks. The role requires prototyping agents for requirement-to-test extraction, verification-plan assistance, regression triage, failure clustering, waveform-analysis guidance, coverage-gap identification and technical reports. It specifies approved engineering-data integration, validation checks, human review, success criteria and evaluation of output accuracy, usefulness and limitations. This records an advertised development and evaluation mandate, not demonstrated deployment.

sources.title: Micron: SR, Engineer - AMS Verification, JR113919 — employer LinkedIn posting
sources.summary: Employer-attributed full job description and JobPosting metadata identify JR113919 and October 5, 2026 as the LinkedIn posting date. The official Careers first-publication date is not established. This is a distinct requisition from the March JR93301 AI-assisted-coding role.
